shared_elements: broadly symmetrical placement of motifs around a central vertical axis
justification: The clearest shared content is schematic anthropomorphic imagery with circular/disc details and incised linear geometric forms arranged with some bilateral symmetry. The biggest difference is that A is a multi-figure scene with flanking figures and a separate horizontal patterned register, while B is dominated by one frontal anthropomorphic figure with large paired circular features and curving bands on the body.
